Name: Fishing Endurance Competition
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.Fishing Endurance Competition adds [b]strategic depth[/b] to Stardew Valley's fishing system. When you hook a fish, both [b]the player[/b] and [b]the fish[/b] have their own stamina bars. By holding the [b]Space key[/b], you consume your own stamina to drain the fish's stamina. Once the fish's stamina is depleted, it becomes exhausted, its movement speed is greatly reduced, giving you the perfect opportunity to reel it in.
[/color]
[line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]🎯 Core Mechanics[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Player Stamina (Circular Ring)
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Displayed below the fishing bar as a [b]128×128 circular ring[/b] (decreases clockwise from 12 o'clock)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Maximum stamina[/b] depends on the fishing rod quality:[/color][/*]
[/list]
[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Rod[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Max Stamina[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Bamboo Pole[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]20[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Training Rod[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]30[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Fiberglass Rod[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]50[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Iridium Rod[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]70[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Advanced Iridium Rod[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]100[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Natural Regeneration[/b]: When not draining, recovers [b]10%[/b] of max stamina per second[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Exhaustion Protection[/b]: When stamina hits 0, draining stops automatically. Must recover to [b]20%[/b] before draining can resume[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Fish Stamina (Yellow Vertical Bar)
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Displayed to the right of the green fishing bar, [b]fills from bottom to top[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stamina Formula[/b]: 
[/color]
[code]20 + Fish Difficulty × 1.5[/code][color=#D4D4D8] (e.g., a difficulty 50 fish has 95 stamina)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]No natural regeneration[/b] — only recovers after exhaustion[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Exhausted Recovery[/b]: Takes [b]5 seconds[/b] to fully recover, during which fish movement speed is reduced by [b]-50%[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Draining Mechanism (Space Key)
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Hold Space[/b]: Consumes player stamina while draining fish stamina equally[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Drain Rate[/b]: 
[/color]
[code]15 + Fishing Level × 2[/code][color=#D4D4D8] (per second)
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Level 0: 15 per second[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Level 10: 35 per second[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Speed Reduction During Drain[/b]: Both player and fish movement speed reduced by [b]-20%[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Equal Exchange[/b]: Every point of stamina you lose, the fish loses the same amount[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Auto Stop[/b]: Draining stops automatically when either stamina reaches zero[/color][/*]
[/list][line]

[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Element[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Description[/color][/th]

[/tr]

[td][color=#D4D4D8]Yellow vertical bar, fills from bottom to top, positioned to the right of the fishing bar (

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]⌨️ Controls[/color][/size][/heading]



[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Action[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Effect[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8][b]Hold Space[/b][/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Begin draining fish stamina (consumes your stamina)[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8][b]Release Space[/b][/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Stop draining, player stamina regenerates[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gamepad X/A[/b][/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]Also supported for draining[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][quote][color=#D4D4D8]💡 [b]Strategy Tip[/b]: Use draining during intense fish movements to stabilize the bar, and release during calm moments to recover stamina. [b]Resource management is the key to victory![/b][/color][/quote][line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]⚙️ Configuration[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]The mod includes a full 
[/color]
[code]config.json[/code][color=#D4D4D8] file with fine-grained control:
json
{
  // Rod stamina caps (customizable)
  "PlayerEnduranceByRod": {
    "BambooPole": 20,
    "TrainingRod": 30,
    "FiberglassRod": 50,

    "AdvancedIridiumRod": 100
  },

  // Fish stamina formula parameters
  "FishEnduranceBase": 20.0,

  "FishBarY": -7,
  "FishBarEmptyX": 0,
  "FishBarEmptyY": 0,
  "FishBarEmptyWidth": 30,
  "FishBarEmptyHeightExtra": 4
}[/color]



[color=#D4D4D8]钓鱼耐力角逐是一款为星露谷钓鱼系统增添[b]策略深度[/b]的模组。当玩家抛出鱼线并咬钩后，[b]玩家[/b]与[b]鱼[/b]各自拥有独立的耐力条。通过按住[b]空格键[/b]消耗自身耐力来削减鱼的耐力，当鱼耐力耗尽时，它将进入力竭状态，移动速度大幅降低，为您创造宝贵的收竿时机。
[/color]
[line]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]🎯 核心机制[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]玩家耐力（圆环）
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]显示在钓鱼框下方，以 [b]128×128 圆形光环[/b]呈现（12点钟方向顺时针减少）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]耐力上限[/b]取决于当前使用的鱼竿品质：[/color][/*]
[/list]

[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]鱼竿[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]耐力上限[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]竹竿[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]20[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]训练竿[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]30[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]玻璃纤维竿[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]50[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]铱金竿[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]70[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]高级铱金竿[/color][/td]
[td][color=#D4D4D8]100[/color][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自然回复[/b]：未消磨时，每秒回复最大耐力的 [b]10%[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]力竭保护[/b]：耐力耗尽后自动停止消磨，需回复至 [b]20%[/b] 以上方可再次消磨[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]鱼耐力（黄色竖条）
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]显示在绿色钓鱼条右侧，[b]从底部向上填充[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]耐力上限公式[/b]：
[/color]
[code]20 + 鱼难度 × 1.5[/code][color=#D4D4D8]（例如难度 50 的鱼拥有 95 耐力）[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]鱼不会自然回复[/b]，只有力竭后才进入回复阶段[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]力竭回复[/b]：耗尽后 [b]5 秒[/b] 内逐渐回复至满，期间鱼游标移动速度 [b]-50%[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]消磨机制（空格键）
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]按住空格键[/b]：消耗玩家耐力，同时对等削减鱼耐力[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]消磨速度[/b]：
[/color]
[code]15 + 钓鱼等级 × 2[/code][color=#D4D4D8]（每秒）
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]0 级钓鱼：每秒 15 点[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]10 级钓鱼：每秒 35 点[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]消磨期间减速[/b]：玩家与鱼的游标移动速度统一 [b]-20%[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]对等消耗[/b]：玩家消耗多少耐力，鱼就损失多少耐力[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]自动停止[/b]：玩家耐力归零或鱼耐力归零时自动停止消磨[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
